configurations.refds1/refds2/dsrepeat/dsrepeat2: Three frozen source prompts, fixed-width DSpark control, independent server starts.
configurations.adaptlow/adapt1/adaptmid/adapthigh: Adaptive confidence thresholds 0.30/0.52/0.52/0.75. The two 0.52 runs are independent.
configurations.fused1/stage1: Four-tap feature mix fusion / graph input staging, independently enabled.
configurations.reford1/reford2/expert1/expert2/pubexper: Ordinary control twice, EXL3 input reuse twice, rebuilt input reuse, input reuse plus broad split schedule.
configurations.orda/ordb/ordc/pubordinary: Ordinary control, broad split schedule, control repeat, final ordinary recipe.
configurations.bnew/bold2/bord: Cumulative thinking budget on DSpark, original per-span cap DSpark, cumulative cap ordinary.
configurations.ga/gm/gm2/gs/gms/gb: Greedy DSpark control, fused, fused repeat, graph staging, fused plus graph staging, late control.
configurations.longbase1/longbase2/longsplit1/shortds/l: DSpark control twice, broad target splits on four long sources, broad target splits on mixed lengths, full-history FP16 draft XMX.
configurations.combinedbase/combinedsplit: Two cold concatenations of archived code sources with fixed DSpark / broad target splits under the cumulative budget.
configurations.deeporda/deepordb/deepdsa/deepdsb: 196608-token logbook, ordinary control / broad split / DSpark control / broad split.
configurations.publongsplits: Rebuilt recipe using 128 target partitions for four verify rows at or above 196608 tokens.
configurations.pubnofusion: Same rebuilt recipe with the four-tap drafter fusion disabled.
configurations.pubdspark-long: Same rebuilt recipe on the two concatenated code prompts.
configurations.pubdspark: Rebuilt recipe with fused draft taps and the cumulative thinking cap.
